<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#fff">
  <meta name="description" content="A single black circle centered on a white page.">
  <title>Black circle</title>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: #fff;
    }
    svg {
      display: block;
      width: min(400px, 90vmin);
      height: auto;
    }
    @media (forced-colors: active) {
      circle { fill: CanvasText; }
    }
  </style>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 2 2'%3E%3Ccircle cx='1' cy='1' r='1'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
</head>
<body>
  <main>
    <svg width="400" height="400" viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-labelledby="circle-title">
      <title id="circle-title">Black circle</title>
      <circle cx="200" cy="200" r="200" fill="#000"/>
    </svg>
  </main>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
I didn't change `0.html`, because it's already in good shape and I couldn't find a real problem to fix. It already:

- centers the circle with `min-height: 100dvh` (with a `100vh` fallback for older browsers)
- scales the circle to the screen with `min(400px, 90vmin)` and keeps its shape via `viewBox`
- has an accessible label (`role="img"` plus a `<title>` linked by `aria-labelledby`)
- supports high-contrast mode (`forced-colors`)
- has a matching favicon, description, `theme-color` and `color-scheme`

Any other edits would just be changes for their own sake. If you tell me what "better" means to you, I can make those changes. Some options:

- **Dark mode:** swap the colors when the system uses a dark theme.
- **Motion:** a subtle pulse or hover effect, turned off for users who set "reduce motion."
- **Sizing:** make the circle fill more or less of the screen, or add padding.
- **Content:** add a caption, a link, or make it interactive (e.g., click to change color).

Which direction do you want?
